text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGING eng-oncall — high 95th latency and quota-exhaust errors affecting hosted inference in eu-west; traffic spike ~3x last 10m, 5% 5xx on /v1/generate. Runbook: traffic-mitigation suggested.

eng-oncall: on it, picking up triage. can someone post the topline customer impact?

Anna R: seeing 20% of free-tier requests time out at 10s, a few enterprise customers (acme-inc, dataplu) reporting degraded responses. Region-specific—eu-west sensors show CPU queueing on the inference pool.

Mike T: I can take live steering. hypothesis: regional capacity saturated + some aggressive burst traffic from a couple of clients. Recommend: 1) temporary tiered rate cap for free tiers 2) steer lower-priority traffic to eu-central fallback lane 3) enable model-size fallback for non-critical requests.

Leo S: dashboards up — latency 95p jumped to 620ms, error rate 5xx=5.1%. KV cache miss rate spiked, batch sizes are small so throughput collapsed.

Maya C: suggest canary 10% reroute first, run 5m, watch p95 and errors. If good, ramp to 40% then 100%. Also propose lowering default concurrency for free tier from 8->4.

eng-oncall: ack. running the canary now. Applying smart-routing policy patch (canary=10%).

Mike T: posting the runbook command I'm using — copy/paste:
```bash
# create temporary policy to steer non-paying traffic to fallback lane
infractl routing apply --name rapid-steer-001 \\n  --match 'tier:free' --action 'route:eu-central' --weight 10

# reduce free-tier concurrency and set soft QPS cap
infractl quota update --tier free --concurrency 4 --qps 150
```

Anna R: doing support triage — pinged acme-inc + dataplu and flagged that we're doing tiered rate limiting; offering enterprise SLA priority lane if they need immediate relief. Julie, can support batch a heads-up?

Julie (Support): on it — composing message for the enterprise list and creating a ticket queue for impacted accounts. Also enabling priority assist for any escalations (phone callback enabled).

Leo S: canary is in. Metrics after 2m: canary targets 10% of free-tier; host p95 for main lane down from 620ms -> 350ms, overall 5xx reduced to 2.1%. KV cache reuse improved where traffic moved.

Maya C: good sign. wait 5 more minutes then ramp to 40%. If errors stay below 1% we can keep policy for 2h and then re-evaluate.

eng-oncall: ramping now to 40% and applying temporary soft quota for free tier across eu-west: 100 qps burst 300.

IncidentBot: ACTION LOG — rapid-steer-001 applied by Mike T; canary 10% -> ramp 40% -> soft caps added.

Mike T: also pushed a lightweight fallback model for/XHint header requests (model-small-v1) for free tier to reduce decode cost. Command snippet:
```json
{"policy":"fallback-model","match":{"tier":"free"},"model":"model-small-v1","priority":50}
```

Anna R: estimated customer impact: free-tier users will see occasional rate limiting; enterprise customers should be mostly unaffected (we offered priority lane). No major data loss.

Julie (Support): updated ticket notes; two customers already informed. sending follow-ups.

Leo S: after ramp, latest: overall p95 240ms, 5xx 0.9%, queue depth normalized. Monitoring logs for any tail events.

Maya C: let's keep the policy in place for 2 hours and set an automated rollback if errors spike >2% over 5m. Add health-check alert: if p95 > 400ms revert steering.

eng-oncall: adding automation hook now:
```yaml
on_error_spike:
  threshold: 2.0
  window: 5m
  action: revert_policy rapid-steer-001
on_latency_spike:
  p95: 400ms
  window: 5m
  action: revert_policy rapid-steer-001
```

Mike T: confirming revert path exists and is tested. Also will kick an infra scale request for eu-west (procurement pending) but that will take longer.

IncidentBot: NOTE — page closed? No, status: mitigated, monitoring.

Anna R: thanks team — telemetry looks stable. keeping in monitoring window. Julie, please flag any customer escalations.

Julie (Support): will do. Thanks everyone. putting this thread into incident log and tagging for postmortem if we need a follow-up on traffic shaping thresholds. :white_check_mark:

eng-oncall: final check at end of window we'll either keep a lighter cap or roll back. For now, mitigation successful — latency and errors within acceptable bounds.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated -> monitoring. Close if stable after 2h.
